The first call returned suggestions on GOOGL.p2 (capex) and NVDA.p3 (in-house chips). The claims also raise a debate that no pillar statement mentions: Google-managed TPU pods in third-party sites, which would make TPUs a merchant-style product sold to external customers. The GOOGL pillars cover Search clicks, capex and depreciation margin, and regulation, and none covers this. A new-thesis check for GOOGL is therefore warranted.
